prose: Intel shares closed down 28.58% on Friday - the stock's worst day since the 1970s - after the chipmaker issued weaker-than-expected guidance, wiping roughly $12B off the US government's stake, CNBC reports. The article is blocked to the fetcher (HTTP 403), so the figures come from the feed's report of the piece.
highlights: Intel -28.58% on Friday, its worst day since the 1970s
~$12B erased from the US government's stake
basis: Techmeme summary of the CNBC report; CNBC returns HTTP 403 to the fetcher
